# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps (glasses, watches, earphones). Priority is establishing platform specs and reusable capabilities first, then incrementally delivering features and Apps.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Composite pages/components using Feature state (may depend on Feature)
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Base types and cross-App/cross-platform capabilities
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependency direction: `App → Widget → Feature → Common → Core`. Full layer model: [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure).

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): code and `pubspec.yaml` first, then stable specs, then active architecture docs and ADRs, then draft/planning assets.

`app_configs/` is planning-only and does not participate in the build. `generate_app.dart` is not implemented — do not describe future generation as a current capability.

## Engineering Rules

Read these by intent, not all upfront:

| Need | Source |
|---|---|
| Hard constraints, package boundaries, doc sync | [`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) |
| Step-by-step task flow | [`harness/checklists.md`](harness/checklists.md) |
| Commands and verification scope | [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md) |
| Project workflow Skills | [`skills/INDEX.md`](skills/INDEX.md) |
| Known BLE / Audio / Riverpod / Navigation traps | [`harness/pitfalls.md`](harness/pitfalls.md) |
| Architecture decisions | [`docs/decisions/`](docs/decisions/README.md) |

## Task Navigation

For the full task map, use [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#navigation-by-task). Common agent routes:

| Task | Start with |
|---|---|
| Choose where a change belongs | `docs/architecture.md` |
| New platform capability / Core package | `specs/README.md`, relevant capability spec, `docs/decisions/0002-graded-core-first.md` |
| New Feature / Common / Widget package | `docs/architecture.md`, `harness/rules.md`, then `harness/checklists.md` |
| New App | `docs/app-dev-runbook.md` |
| Implement or redesign a UI page | `skills/ui-page-implementation/SKILL.md` → `docs/ui-page-workflow.md` |
| Cross-module or multi-session work | `skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md` → `docs/plans/README.md` |
| Existing Provider / API lookup | `docs/implementation-status.md` → Provider Quick Reference |
| Native SDK / protocol / transmission docs | `native_app/docs/索引.md` |

## Work and Verification

1. Before implementing complex work, use [`plan-lifecycle`](skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md) to select or create one current active Plan.
2. At close-out, use the relevant checklist or Skill and apply only matching rows from the [`Doc Sync Matrix`](harness/rules.md#doc-sync-matrix).
3. Select verification from [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md#command-selection) and report exactly what was not run. Do not describe untested builds, simulator runs, or device runs as passing.

## Current Request

User asked to commit the just-verified language-list latency fix in `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp`.

## Completed Work

The fix was implemented and verified before the commit request:

- Language-list request now matches native Android:
  - POST with URL query parameters:
    - `pageNum=1`
    - `pageSize=50`
    - `languageId=175`
  - No JSON request body.
- Language picker opens immediately on first tap.
- Loading appears inside the bottom sheet.
- Failed loading displays localized retry UI instead of falling back to a fake Chinese/English-only list.
- Language cache was invalidated/upgraded.
- Added localized strings and generated l10n output.
- Added service contract and immediate-loading Widget tests.
- `tool/verify.sh package packages/feature/ai/feature_translate` passed:
  - Analyze: no issues.
  - All 56 tests passed.
- User confirmed real-device behavior: “OK 可以了”.

## Critical Concurrent Changes

While staging, new user changes appeared in `feature_translate`:

Unstaged related files:

- `packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/config/translate_config.dart`
- `packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/controller/translate_controller.dart`
- `packages/feature/ai/feature_translate/lib/src/pages/face_to_face_translate_page.dart`
- `apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart`
- `apps/pkg_showcase/lib/src/showcase_app.dart`

The staged versions of two files now include those concurrent face-to-face changes:

- `translate_language_service.dart`
  - Cache changed to v4.
  - Added `faceToFaceTranslateLanguagesProvider`.
  - References `config.faceToFaceRequestHeaders`, whose definition is currently unstaged.
- `translate_language_bar.dart`
  - Selects one-key or face-to-face provider based on `faceToFaceStyle`.

Therefore, committing the currently staged set would create a partial/broken commit because required config/App wiring remains unstaged.

Also note a likely bug in the concurrent picker code: retry always invalidates `translateLanguagesProvider`, even when `faceToFace == true`; it should invalidate the selected provider.

## Current Git State

Nine files are staged:

- ARB files and generated l10n files
- `translate_language_bar.dart`
- `translate_language_service.dart`
- `one_key_translate_page_test.dart`
- `translate_language_service_test.dart`

There are many unrelated unstaged user changes. Do not include them casually.

Current branch recent HEAD:

- `f0bb97b5 fix(audio): 避免蓝牙切换重复启动录音`

Earlier language commit exists:

- `760447cf fix(translate): 完善一键翻译语言选择`

## Next Steps

1. Do not commit the current staged state as-is.
2. Inspect the unstaged concurrent face-to-face/config changes and decide the coherent commit boundary.
3. Most pragmatic option:
   - Include the necessary face-to-face config/App wiring and tests if they form one complete change.
   - Fix retry invalidation to target `faceToFaceTranslateLanguagesProvider` when appropriate.
   - Run `tool/verify.sh package packages/feature/ai/feature_translate` again because concurrent changes occurred after the prior successful verification.
   - Run App verification only if App wiring is included.
4. Alternatively, isolate only the confirmed one-key fix by reconstructing staged versions without the concurrent face-to-face additions. Preserve all user changes in the worktree.
5. Review `git diff --cached` and `git diff` before committing.
6. Suggested commit message for the one-key-only scope:
   - `fix(translate): 修复语言列表加载与弹框延迟`

## Constraints

- Preserve all unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
- Use minimal package-scoped verification per root `AGENTS.md`.
- Do not run workspace-wide checks.
- After a successful commit, emit:
